vectors.description: AccelStab reduced Sestak-Berggren fit of the antigenicity dataset.

inputs.model: reduced one-step Sestak-Berggren (AccelStab): Y depends on C0, k3 and t exp(k1 - k2/T); k2 = Ea/R

our_recomputation.foundation_note: foundation recomputation (Python float64, numpy, 2026-11-14, R = N_A k_B = 8.31446261815324 J/(mol K)), not a published value

tolerance.basis: published to 3 decimals; not checked by the foundation

vectors.source_status: read (vignette; equation printed as an image)
vectors.note: The dataset ships in the CRAN AccelStab package and is not in the research notes or this repository; the exact model algebra must be taken from the package source. Skip unless the dataset is supplied. Vaccine data: tests the fitting code, not the chemistry.
